widgets.name: voice_1
widgets.tip: The voice part 1 plays: choose one in the Browser, or turn the part off

widgets.name: rcv_1
widgets.tip: The channel this part receives on: 1-16, the performance channel (Pfm), or off

widgets.name: rcv_max_1
widgets.tip: The top of a channel range, or Off for the one channel

widgets.name: keys_1
widgets.tip: Drag a key to move the nearer end of the range. The triangle over the keys is the note shift, where middle C lands: drag it along its line, or double-click there for none

widgets.name: reserve_1
widgets.tip: Notes reserved for this part, of the 32

widgets.name: velocity_1
widgets.tip: Velocity in, across; velocity out, up. The left handle drags the range's low end and the offset, the right one the high end and the depth

widgets.name: vel_depth_1
widgets.tip: Velocity sense depth: 64 plays velocity as it comes

widgets.name: mono_1
widgets.tip: Monophonic: one note at a time

widgets.name: prio_last_1
widgets.tip: Last: the note played last sounds

widgets.name: prio_top_1
widgets.tip: Top: the highest note held sounds

widgets.name: prio_bottom_1
widgets.tip: Bottom: the lowest note held sounds

widgets.name: prio_first_1
widgets.tip: First: the note held longest sounds
